subject: french
title: Arts and Expression
welcome_lead: Human Ingenuity covers art, music, literature and innovation. France's artistic heritage is a treasure trove.
meta_desc: French: arts, music, literature, and creative expression.
final_note: Art needs language — to discuss it is to extend it.

walkthroughs.body_html: Use au premier plan (foreground), a l'arriere-plan (background). For colours: les teintes pastel. For impression: l'artiste cherche a capter la lumiere.
Impressionnisme: Monet, Renoir. Cubisme: Picasso, Braque. Surrealisme: Breton, Dali. Each shaped how we see.
For Paper 1/2: L'art a-t-il un role social? Use certes. cependant. for balanced argument.
